title: Input: one KeyGuy driven by the controls methods, one MouseTrap with camera controllers (orbit, 2D pan, fly, third person)
description:
Repo plan phase 2.5, merges 3A.4-5 and 3D.18 (orbit part). Key handlers: KeyGuy, Camera2DInputController, MainSceneKeyGuy, TradeKeyGuy, OrbitCameraKeyGuy, DungeonKeyGuy. Mouse: MouseTrap (wired to MainScene and PaneTypes, 156-171), OrbitMouseTrap, TradeMouseTrap (drag-pan duplicating Scene2DMousePanTrap), Scene2DMousePanTrap, FlyCamMouseTrap; plus a second click-region API MouseTrap.subscribeClickRegion with one caller (ShaderCodePane.java:135). Orbit state has three owners: Camera3D, OrbitMouseTrap (50-120), ThirdPersonCamera. Target: KeyGuy dispatches whatever ControlHint rows the scene and active tool list (the existing 3D model), keeping terminal ownership and automation's key-consumed accounting; MouseTrap routes through PointerDispatcher to the tool and to a camera controller (orbit, 2D pan, fly, third person) held as a strategy, with the orbit state on Camera3D. Modifier constants (KeyNames, OrbitCameraKeyGuy, OrbitMouseTrap) become KeyNames only. Keep the class names KeyGuy and MouseTrap.

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.
definition-of-done:
1. One KeyGuy and one MouseTrap class family member each (subclasses gone or justified); subscribeClickRegion gone.
2. Orbit, pan, fly and third-person feel unchanged (the user verifies by hand); the automation orbit-get/orbit-set routes work.
3. Unit suite passes; launch entries and screenshots in the mesh viewer, TSP, trade and dungeon scenes.
testing-plan:
1. mvn test.
2. Live: each scene's camera and keys; ixdar-cli key/click/orbit routes.
changes-made: Input merge (uncommitted in worktree eng-27, wt done NOT run: one design question open, see below). One KeyGuy: fires the first matching ControlHint row on a first press (repeats fire only repeatsWhileHeld rows on the 360 ms timer), keeps terminal ownership and keysConsumed; release fires nothing; per frame it hands held keys to the scene's camera controller. Gone: OrbitCameraKeyGuy, MainSceneKeyGuy, TradeKeyGuy, DungeonKeyGuy, Camera2DInputController, KeyActions.Back/Reset, OrbitCameraKeyGuy.MOD_CONTROL (KeyNames only). Their behaviour became rows: ModelScene ctrl+R re-centre orbit (skipped when a tool binds ctrl+R, replacing controlRResetsTarget), MenuScene esc back, DungeonViewerScene F/V/esc/R, IrregularGridScene R; Scene's ~ row only when the scene has a terminal. One MouseTrap: holds a CameraController strategy (graphics/cameras/CameraController interface) and calls Scene.viewHovered/viewClicked (MainScene panes, TradeScene city hover, MenuScene menu; default = active tool); automation hover lock moved onto MouseTrap (was TradeMouseTrap). Gone: OrbitMouseTrap, Scene2DMousePanTrap, MainSceneMouseTrap, TradeMouseTrap, FlyCamMouseTrap, procgen/dungeon/scene package, MouseTrap.subscribeClickRegion (now PointerDispatcher.clickRegions + PointerRegion.onClick; ShaderCodePane its one user). Controllers: Camera3D implements orbit (orbit state azimuth/elevation/distance/bounds/orbitTarget/homeTarget now on Camera3D), Camera2D implements 2D pan/zoom (wheelZooms=false for the TSP editor whose wheel goes to its pane regions), FlyController (new: fly-cam/captured first-person look), ThirdPersonCamera (existing class, now a controller whose follow angles/distance live on Camera3D yaw/pitch/distance). orbit-get also reports the active camera pose (3D) or pan/zoom (2D). Verified: mvn test 525 run 0 failures (BisectorTest 6/6); eng-26 tsp/trade/3d scripts identical to the eng-26 baseline run in this worktree (trade city count is random); ring fingerprints sha256 9b5924.../7304dc... and bisector 5bb2a0af558f3140/ce0f49624801b4d1 identical; tmp/eng-27-camera.sh scripted orbit/pan/fly/third-person trajectories identical except: TSP drag no longer also clicks at its press point on release (old MouseTrap never updated lastX while dragging), 2D wheel zoom is frame-time dependent (rough lines). Launch entries ENG-27: mesh-viewer, ixdar-canvas, ixdar, dungeon-viewer; screenshots tmp/eng-27-*.png. OPEN: KeyGuy/MouseTrap/PointerDispatcher still import scenes.Scene, scenes.main.Toggle, gui Terminal/HyperString, tools ControlHint/Tool (ENG-20 note) - awaiting the user's choice between moving them out of platform/input or inverting through an interface.

Coordinator ruling (option A): KeyGuy, MouseTrap, PointerDispatcher and SceneInputFrameUpdater moved, names unchanged, to new top-level package ixdar.input (package-info: scene-level input dispatch); Keys, KeyNames, KeyActions, MouseButtons, PointerRegion stay in ixdar.platform.input. To keep platform free of ixdar.input: the key-consumed counter moved KeyGuy.keysConsumed/markKeyConsumed -> KeyActions (InjectKey reads it there); AutomationBackend.bindInput(Platform, KeyGuy, MouseTrap) -> bindInput(Platform, Scene) and Scene.bindAutomationIfAvailable(platform) is now an instance method; PointerRegion's javadoc no longer links the moved classes. MouseTrap.mouseClicked inlined into mouseButton (its one caller). Remaining platform -> upper-layer imports: only AutomationBackend -> scenes.Scene (pre-existing, left by ruling). ixdar.input imports scenes (Scene, main.Toggle), gui (Terminal, HyperString) and tools (ControlHint, Tool) by design. Re-verified after the move: mvn test 525/0 (BisectorTest 6/6); eng-26 tsp, trade (route ops) and 3d scripts identical to baseline (ring sha256 and bisector fingerprints byte-identical); camera script identical for orbit, ring, fly, first/third person; the only diffs are the TSP drag no longer clicking at its press point on release (so a drag that started over the info pane no longer moves focus there, and the next R reset fires), random trade city layout, and frame-time-dependent 2D wheel zoom. wt done passed (launch ENG-27: mesh-viewer, screenshot tmp/eng-27-launch.png); ticket REVIEW. Stale docs: Ixdar/CLAUDE.md generated command list (orbit-get/hover-clear descriptions here, plus earlier tickets' click/scroll/bisect/dsl-graph lines) left at HEAD; REFACTOR-PLAN-2.md still names the old classes.
